triples.subject: Alexey
triples.quote: Yes, the trial’s to-morrow. Are you so hopeless, brother?” Alyosha said, with an apprehensive feeling.

triples.subject: Mitya
triples.quote: Rakitin explained it all to me yesterday, brother, and it simply bowled me over.

triples.subject: Mitya
triples.quote: Damn ethics, I am done for, Alexey, I am, you man of God! I love you more than any one.

triples.subject: Mitya
triples.quote: The Karamazovs are not blackguards, but philosophers; for all true Russians are philosophers

triples.subject: Mitya
triples.quote: A clever man knows his way about, but you’ve put your foot in it, committing a murder, and now you are rotting in prison.

triples.subject: Rakitin
triples.quote: Rakitin fired up instantly. “You’d better give that advice to your own family, who’ve always been a slave-driving lot, and not to Rakitin,” he cried

triples.subject: Rakitin
triples.quote: He can’t bear Ivan, he hates him. He’s not fond of you, either.

triples.subject: Rakitin
triples.quote: Rakitin did not like meeting Alyosha, especially of late. He scarcely spoke to him, and bowed to him stiffly.

triples.subject: Mihail Mihailovitch
triples.quote: His abuse of her at Mokroe weighed on the old man’s conscience, and when he learned the whole story, he completely changed his view of her.

triples.subject: Rakitin
triples.quote: And he told me he was courting Madame Hohlakov. She hadn’t much brains in her youth, and now at forty she has lost what she had.

triples.subject: Perhotin
triples.quote: And then, all of a sudden, he was turned out of the house. Perhotin’s carrying everything before him, bravo!

triples.subject: Mitya
triples.quote: He wants to say ‘he couldn’t help murdering his father, he was corrupted by his environment,’ and so on.

triples.subject: Abuse of Grushenka
triples.quote: His abuse of her at Mokroe weighed on the old man’s conscience

triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch
triples.quote: ‘Fyodor Pavlovitch, our papa,’ he said, ‘was a pig, but his ideas were right enough.’

triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch
triples.quote: ‘Fyodor Pavlovitch, our papa,’ he said, ‘was a pig, but his ideas were right enough.’

triples.subject: Alexey
triples.quote: “Brother, I cannot stay long,” Alyosha said, after a pause.

triples.subject: Ivan
triples.quote: “What of brother Ivan?” interrupted Alyosha, but Mitya did not hear.

triples.subject: Mitya
triples.quote: Grusha’s killing me; the thought of her’s killing me, killing me. She was with me just now....

triples.subject: Mitya
triples.quote: Grigory’s my enemy. And there are some people who are better as foes than friends.

triples.subject: Mitya
triples.quote: “She told me she was very much grieved by you to-day.” “I know. Confound my temper! It was jealousy.

triples.subject: Mitya
triples.quote: Remember that rule given you by your brother Mitya, who’s come to ruin through women.

triples.subject: Mitya
triples.quote: Though I say that Ivan is superior to us, you are my angel.

triples.subject: Alexey
triples.quote: and his yearning, feverish eyes were fixed on his brother’s.

triples.subject: Mitya
triples.quote: I worship her, Alexey, worship her. Only she doesn’t see it.

triples.subject: Grushenka
triples.quote: And she tortures me, tortures me with her love.
